assessment_scope: 0.1.1 desktop browser build (assessed while VERSION is still 0.1.0; the 0.1.1 release commit bumps this record's version field): the six compiled DICE circuits (Pong, Pong Doubles, Space Race, Breakout, Stunt Cycle, Indy 4) with the portable chip-ROM adapter, compiled with Emscripten 3.1.74, and the minimal desktop frontend (keyboard/mouse/gamepad controls, settings, player-supplied ROM loading through fflate, About panel with build string, notices and source link). The touch controls, Home Screen manifest and PNG icons and the qualification collector of 0.1.0 are removed. Reviewed against the actual local build output, its notices and its corresponding-source archive. It covers browser JS/Wasm/asset distribution only; native binaries, toolchain containers, ROM payloads and the fifteen unported DICE circuits are excluded. It makes no gameplay, accuracy or browser-compatibility claim.

components.scope: NoCPU-maintained core adapters (core/), browser frontend (web/src, web/index.html), SVG icon, and the original DICE 0.9 sources compiled for the six circuits
components.license: GPL-3.0-only combined; NoCPU and DICE grants GPL-3.0-or-later individually
components.basis: tests/license-audit.json and docs/PROVENANCE.md; DICE sources are prepared unchanged from upstream/dice-0.9 (tests/source-manifest.json)

components.scope: Emscripten generated JavaScript (core/nocpu.js) and runtime support code
components.license: MIT option of MIT / NCSA dual license
components.basis: Installed compiler reports 3.1.74 (1092ec30a3fb1d46b1782ff1b4db5094d3d06ae5); retained LICENSE and AUTHORS are byte-identical to the installed SDK files; runtime source headers retained.

components.scope: LLVM libc++, libc++abi and compiler-rt members linked into the Wasm module
components.basis: Linker map: libc++ 12, libc++abi 10, compiler-rt 18 members. Retained LICENSE.TXT and CREDITS.TXT are byte-identical to the installed SDK files.

components.scope: musl libc members linked into the Wasm module, including 27 math routines
components.license: MIT for musl and the Arm-derived routines; the Sun-derived trigonometric routines keep their notice-preservation grant; fmaf (FreeBSD, David Schultz) is BSD-2-Clause
components.basis: Linker map: libc 103 members. Math members: __cosdf, __fpclassifyl, __math_divzero, __math_invalid, __math_oflow, __math_uflow, __math_xflow, __rem_pio2_large, __rem_pio2f, __sindf, copysignl, cosf, exp, exp_data, fabsl, floor, fmaf, fmod, fmodl, frexp, log, log_data, lroundf, roundf, scalbn, scalbnl, sinf — the 26 of the reviewed legacy 0.6.0 inventory plus fmaf, which the 0.1.1 Indy 4 renderer fix pulls in through std::fma, together with the header-less fenv member. Retained COPYRIGHT is byte-identical to the installed SDK file; the Sun, Arm and FreeBSD fmaf headers are retained verbatim in docs/licenses/musl-emscripten-3.1.74-MATH-NOTICES.txt (fmaf.c SHA-256 8cef4678e7e82d5be0775e51ac11bbcb680f39005482470f5cfb3ed201cd3620); the installed fmod.c (SHA-256 33fb61093e04783081b9e8f8a8a303456b2f919c215cd0c378c1ed0acf41934c) and fenv.c have no additional header.

components.scope: dlmalloc allocator and Emscripten support stubs linked into the Wasm module
components.license: CC0 / public-domain dedication for dlmalloc; Emscripten changes and stubs MIT
components.basis: Linker map: dlmalloc 2, noexit 1, stubs 1 members. Doug Lea's dedication and the Emscripten notices are retained.

components.scope: Vite modulepreload helper injected into the application bundle
components.basis: Installed vite 7.3.1; retained LICENSE.md is byte-identical to node_modules/vite/LICENSE.md.

components.scope: fflate ZIP deflate helper used by the local ROM-file validator
components.basis: The only npm runtime dependency in the frontend build provenance (node_modules/fflate/esm/browser.js); package, lockfile integrity and installed copy match the 0.8.2 pin checked by tools/package-web.py. Retained license is byte-identical to the installed package; unmodified preferred source (upstream/fflate-0.8.2) ships in the source archive; UZIP.js MIT attribution retained.

corresponding_source.delivery: tools/package-web.py builds the archive from the same checkout into the packaged site with its .sha256, links it from the app, and the release workflow attaches it as nocpu-0.1.0-source.tar.gz. It holds the unchanged DICE 0.9 sources, NoCPU core adapters and frontend, the fflate preferred source, the icon SVG, build scripts, lockfiles, manifests and all notices; it excludes Git metadata, ROMs, private fixtures, build output and compiled payloads.

review.by: Agent review (the integrating agent, not independent) of the actual local 0.1.1 build output on restart/desktop-first after merging wip/0.1.1-indy4-row213 and wip/post-1.0-evidence and making the Wasm build path-independent (commits 72ef2aa..ec19823 plus this audit), built in a clean clone.
findings: Shipped runtime: 7 files from build/web — index.html, assets/index-*.js (application with fflate and the Vite modulepreload helper), assets/core.worker-*.js, assets/index-*.css, core/nocpu.js (Emscripten glue), core/nocpu.wasm and icon.svg. No manifest.webmanifest, no PNG icons and no tools/render-icons.mjs. Local review runtime SHA-256 1c2430a76fa95695954e6d8c09879cdc665847211540d80ca46b3ed755618cc9; core/nocpu.wasm becf728c28422763a2ced9f6f3b5094807c6e706c82c00ab9342afb0af0e8607 (changed by the Indy 4 renderer fix and the path-independent system libraries); core/nocpu.js 623c8478e5669bfe254719c5b3ccb3fa58e2302b059d0b96283e32f81f99248a (unchanged). Release packaging recomputes and records these in BUILD-MANIFEST.json.

Reproducibility: tools/build-core.sh builds the Emscripten system libraries with embuilder's deterministic paths into a dedicated cache and links with a frozen cache; nocpu.wasm and nocpu.js were byte-identical when built in three checkouts at different paths and depths, including /home/runner/work/NoCPU/NoCPU.

Wasm link inventory (build/core/wasm/linker.map): 67 compiled NoCPU/DICE units plus seven SDK archive families with 147 members — libc 103, compiler-rt 18, libc++ 12, libc++abi 10, dlmalloc 2, noexit 1, stubs 1. New since 0.1.0: libc fmaf.o (BSD-2-Clause header now retained in the MATH-NOTICES file, whose hash changed accordingly in this audit and in tests/license-audit.json) and fenv.o (no header; musl MIT). build/core/wasm/dependencies.mk lists only core/ and prepared DICE sources.

Core changes since v0.1.0: core/platform/portable_video.inc (the Indy 4 renderer fix, matching llvmpipe's viewport and fill rules) and core/README.md; no new dependency. Frontend changes are NoCPU-owned; package.json and package-lock.json still pin one runtime dependency, fflate 0.8.2, and build/web-provenance.json records no other node_modules input.

The 27 notices: Emscripten LICENSE, LLVM libc++/libc++abi/compiler-rt LICENSE and musl COPYRIGHT are byte-identical to the installed Emscripten 3.1.74 SDK, and the Vite and fflate licenses to the installed npm packages; the musl MATH-NOTICES file gains the fmaf.c header. The packaged site carries all 27 under notices/ with matching hashes, plus notices/browser-license-audit.json and source/nocpu-0.1.0-source.tar.gz with its .sha256; the zip, tarball and source checksums verify.

The source archive (802 files: the 801 tracked files plus RELEASE-MANIFEST.json) holds all 566 original DICE files, core/, web/ (web/public/icon.svg is its only public asset), tools/, upstream/fflate-0.8.2, lockfiles, manifests and every notice; it has no Git metadata, build output, node_modules, compiled payloads, ROMs, PNG icons, manifest.webmanifest or tools/render-icons.mjs.

No member of the ten private fixture archives in build/roms (44 members) appears raw or base64-encoded (three alignments) in the web zip, the web tarball, the packaged site or the source archive, including archives nested in the zip; tests/test-dev-rom-exclusion.py --require-build passes on the production bundle with fixtures present.
